capabilities: Manage tasks in backlog, upcoming, and later columns with drag-and-drop
Plan tasks in a seven-day week view with week navigation
Plan tasks in a twelve-month year view
Link tasks created from vault notes back to those notes
Archive the current planner state to a Markdown note
extras: Desktop-only plugin (per manifest isDesktopOnly). Bilingual UI with English and Simplified Chinese toggle. Not yet listed for community-plugin install; manual install instructions provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in task board or planner views, so tasks scattered across notes are hard to organize by urgency or schedule.
summary: Task manager that adds a kanban-style task board plus week and year planner views with drag-and-drop and note archiving.
